select from u_s_storage order by provider
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_storage( provider, endpoint, region, access_key_id, access_key_secret, bucket, public_url, status, active, createtime, updatetime, create_by, update_by ) values( #{provider}, #{endpoint}, #{region}, #{accessKeyId}, #{accessKeySecret}, #{bucket}, #{publicUrl}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), coalesce(#{active}, '0'), sysdate(), sysdate(), #{createBy}, #{updateBy} ) on duplicate key update endpoint = values(endpoint), region = values(region), access_key_id = values(access_key_id), access_key_secret = coalesce(values(access_key_secret), access_key_secret), bucket = values(bucket), public_url = values(public_url), status = values(status), active = values(active), updatetime = sysdate(), update_by = values(update_by)
mapper.update: update u_s_storage set active = '0', updatetime = sysdate() where provider != #{provider} and active = '1'
